_comment: Drives the WORKING ON IT page. Re-read on every request, so edits show without a restart. Public repo: no teammate names here; cite suggestions by #id. status: now | next | later | done

updates.title: Launch week
items: Blind rating: results stay sealed until you've filed your own report
Dry Land Purists can skip the dunk ratings
Agent dossiers with your Soulmate and Nemesis biscuit
Live presence in the control room, so nobody gets cut off mid-review
E-STOP button. You know what it's for.
Dashboard: biscuit drops timeline, your next tasting, and a scouting report of UK biscuits nobody's tried yet
Cases go public a week after logging. The leaderboard now shows every biscuit's name and place, with only the score sealed
Closed cases for biscuits that leave the shops, plus reopen requests when they come back
👍 on other agents' field reports. Funny ones will earn Biscuit Points
🪙 Biscuit Points: earn for reports, proper field notes, thumbs-ups, new specimens, drops and suggestions. Tap your badge to see your tally and rank
🛍️ The Biscuit Shop: spend points on titles, name colours and avatar frames. Spending never lowers your rank
🛰️ Biscuit Radar (Dashboard → Radar): shops around HQ by distance, team-reported prices, and the cheapest place for each biscuit

roadmap.title: Weekly updates from your suggestions
roadmap.blurb: Every week the suggestion box gets reviewed, the best ideas get built, and they show up here.

roadmap.title: Dashboard: limited-edition drops
roadmap.blurb: A timeline of UK limited-time biscuit releases (logged by you lot, so keep it topped up), plus 'you might like' picks.

roadmap.title: Cases go public after a week
roadmap.blurb: A week after a biscuit is logged, its results unseal for everyone. Before then the leaderboard shows the biscuit, just not its score.

roadmap.title: Limited-time cases
roadmap.blurb: When a biscuit leaves the shelves, its case closes and is filed as 'no longer available'.

roadmap.title: Reopen requests
roadmap.blurb: Spotted a discontinued biscuit back in the shops? Request its case be reopened.

roadmap.title: Biscuit Points and the Biscuit Shop
roadmap.blurb: Earn points by reviewing; spend them on titles, name colours and avatar frames.

roadmap.title: Biscuit radius map
roadmap.blurb: Shops near the office with biscuit prices that the team can add to and correct.
